strings.intro: Upload and organise documents, libraries and sections.
strings.private: Changes stay in this manager until a new library release is published.
strings.load_error: The workspace could not be loaded. Check the local connection and try again.
strings.library_deleted: Library deleted; its documents are retained.
strings.operation_error: The change could not be saved. Your form is still here so you can try again.
strings.empty_catalogue_help: Set up Oasis Knowledge, then add libraries and documents.
strings.setup_catalogue_help: Prepare Oasis Knowledge for your libraries and documents. You can add a library after setup.
strings.version_help: Start with a letter or number, then use letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens. For example: oasis-library-v1. The identifier is used by export tools.
strings.no_libraries_help: Add a named library such as Farming or Water. Existing originals can belong to more than one library.
strings.library_delete_help: This removes the library and its {count} child sections from the current catalogue. Original documents and their metadata are retained. Membership in other libraries is retained.
strings.confirm_library: Type the library name to confirm
strings.section_deleted: Section deleted; its documents are retained.
strings.section_delete_help: This removes the section and its {count} child sections from the current catalogue. Original documents and their metadata are retained. Membership in other libraries and sections is retained.
strings.confirm_section: Type the section name to confirm
strings.documents_error: These documents could not be loaded. Try again.
strings.loading_editor_help: Loading metadata values for this form…
strings.editor_error: The document form could not be loaded. Try again.
strings.search_metadata_help: Filter document titles, descriptions, authors and other catalogue metadata.
strings.search_pdf_text_help: Search extracted PDF passages in the selected private draft index. Submit a query to search.
strings.search_ai_semantic_help: Find related PDF passages using the configured local embedding model. Submit a query to search.
strings.indexed_search_placeholder: Words or a question about these PDFs
strings.indexed_search_capability_error: Private search availability could not be loaded.
strings.indexed_search_text_available: Local PDF text search is available.
strings.indexed_search_text_unavailable: The private PDF text index is unavailable.
strings.indexed_search_semantic_available: Semantic search is available with the configured local embedding model and matching vectors.
strings.indexed_search_draft_help: Private draft passages from the current catalogue and any chosen library or section. Other catalogue documents remain accessible through metadata search.
strings.indexed_search_coverage: In this scope: {eligible} eligible PDFs · {indexed} current · {stale} stale · {unindexed} not indexed. Stale and unindexed originals are excluded from passage search.
strings.indexed_search_error: The private passage search could not be completed. Try again.
strings.indexed_search_text_results: {count} matching passages from PDF text search.
strings.indexed_search_semantic_results: {count} matching passages from AI semantic search.
strings.indexed_search_no_attribution: No author, publisher or licence recorded in this private index.
strings.indexed_search_no_results: No matching passages in the current private index.
strings.indexed_search_prompt: Enter a query and select Search to inspect matching passages.
strings.no_documents: No documents in this library yet
strings.no_documents_section: No documents in this section yet
strings.no_documents_help: Upload an original document or select All documents to organise existing files.
strings.no_files_help: Upload an original file to begin your catalogue.
strings.unassigned: No library assigned in this catalogue
strings.file_help: Choose an original document to store locally. The file remains available without internet access.
strings.replacement_help: A replacement updates the original everywhere this document appears.
strings.file_required: Choose an original file before uploading.
strings.title: Title
strings.rights_help: Record the licence, permissions and any exceptions for this document. Uploading does not establish permission to publish it.
strings.membership_help: Choose a library, then a section within it. A document can belong to several libraries or sections.
strings.no_membership_help: Create a library in Manage Library before uploading documents.
strings.metadata_help: Select existing values or add a new field and value. Values can be reused for other documents.
strings.field_help: For example: Creator, Source, Licence or Language.
strings.metadata_error: The metadata value could not be saved. Try again.
strings.no_metadata_types: No metadata fields yet. Add a field to record author, source, licence or language information.
strings.last_updated_help: When the catalogue record or original file was last saved. Publication, rights review and indexing dates are separate.
strings.date_help: A recorded review date does not establish approval for technical advice.
strings.active_help: This is the existing catalogue flag. It is not an approval or publishing record.
strings.duplicatable_help: Keep the existing export preference. The document’s rights statement determines permitted uses.
strings.edit_scope: The document’s details, metadata and original file are shared everywhere it appears. Library and section membership changes apply to the current catalogue.
strings.invalid_response: The catalogue returned an invalid response.
strings.incomplete_response: The catalogue returned an incomplete list.
strings.index_draft_help: Rebuilding prepares your PDFs for text and optional AI search in this manager. Visitors keep using the published library until a new release is published.
strings.index_status_error: Index status could not be loaded. Document management is still available.
strings.index_outside_catalogue: No index status returned for this document in the selected catalogue.
strings.index_worker_inactive: Search rebuilds are paused. Existing search stays available; queued rebuilds wait until the worker resumes.
strings.index_truncated_ids: First 100 IDs shown; {count} documents are affected.
strings.index_scope_help: The current worker rebuilds the complete selected catalogue snapshot ({count} eligible PDFs), even when requested for one document or library. PDF extraction and optional vector generation can take time and computing resources.
strings.index_text_profile_help: Extract PDF pages and build local text search.
strings.index_hybrid_profile_help: Also build vectors using the configured local embedding model.
strings.index_queued_notice: Search rebuild queued. Open Search maintenance for progress and details.
strings.index_queue_error: The index job could not be queued. Check the reason and try again.
strings.delete_document_help: Delete “{name}” ({file}) and its original file from the whole catalogue. It will be removed from every library. Existing exported copies are separate and are not recalled.
strings.advanced_help: Tools for metadata, library images, offline modules and host information.
strings.advanced_error: Advanced tools could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
strings.placement_required: Choose a library for this document before uploading. Select a section too if one applies.
strings.empty_edit_placement_help: Saving with no placements removes this document from the current catalogue. Its original file and placements in other catalogues are retained.
strings.new_section_assignment_help: The new section will be created here and selected for this document. It remains in the catalogue if you cancel the document form.
strings.bulk_file_location_help: Leave blank to update existing document metadata only; existing library and section memberships will be preserved.
strings.bulk_load_error: The file import form could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
strings.bulk_placement_help: These placements apply to every new document in this batch. Split batches when documents need different libraries or sections.
strings.bulk_error: The import could not be completed. Check the details and try again.
strings.bulk_sheet_required: Choose a metadata spreadsheet before importing.
strings.bulk_read_error: The spreadsheet could not be read.
strings.library_already_selected: This document already belongs directly to this library. Choose an additional section, or cancel.
